meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 在成功执行编辑操作（如 apply_patch、write 等）后，若评论检查器报告警告，Claude 会先修复或解释被标记的评论，再继续后续任务。
howto.when: 在成功执行 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑工具后，评论检查器自动触发，并根据结果给出阻塞反馈。

say.text: 请修复这个被标记的注释，使其符合规范。
解释一下为什么这段代码中的注释有问题。
say.note: Claude 会给出解释并可能修复。

say.text: 检查最近编辑的代码，确保所有注释都正确。
say.note: Claude 会启动评论检查器并处理警告。

howto.what_en: After installing, when Codex successfully performs an edit tool (e.g., apply_patch, write) and comment-checker reports a warning, Codex will fix or explain the flagged comment before proceeding.
howto.when_en: Triggered automatically after a successful apply_patch, write, edit, etc., comment-checker emits blocking feedback if a warning is found.

say_en.text: Please fix this flagged comment to meet the standards.
Explain why this comment in the code has an issue.
say_en.note: Codex will give an explanation and may fix it.

say_en.text: Check recent edits to ensure all comments are correct.
say_en.note: Codex will run the comment checker and handle warnings.
